CATALOG_MANIFEST_RESOURCE_DUPLICATE: manifest repeats a type and slug

CATALOG_MANIFEST_DETAIL_UNDECLARED: detail file has no manifest entry
CATALOG_DEPENDENCY_REFERENCE_MISSING: declared external dependency cannot be resolved

CATALOG_KEYWORD_INVALID: catalog keyword is blank or has surrounding whitespace
CATALOG_PRESENTATION_RESOURCE_NOT_ASSET: presentation reference resolves only to a non-asset resource
CATALOG_PRESENTATION_ASSET_MEDIA_TYPE_IN: presentation asset is not an image
CATALOG_ASSET_PATH_INVALID: asset contentUrl is not a safe canonical path
CATALOG_FONT_VARIANT_INVALID: font weight is outside the CSS range
CATALOG_FONT_VARIANT_DUPLICATE: font repeats a weight and italic face
CATALOG_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES_CONFLICT: attribute mixes inline values and a code-list binding
CATALOG_TEMPLATE_DATA_SCHEMA_INVALID: template data schema has an invalid shape
CATALOG_TEMPLATE_DATA_EXAMPLE_INVALID: example does not satisfy the template data schema
